name: Citi Simplicity Card

rewards.on: no rewards program — this card is designed for paying off debt, not earning rewards

regular_apr: 19.24% to 29.99% variable, depending on your credit
intro_apr: 0% for 21 months on balance transfers and 12 months on purchases from date of first transfer
rating_reason: The 21-month balance transfer window is among the longest we cover. No late fees and no penalty APR make it forgiving. No rewards program means it should be a temporary tool, not your everyday card.
best_for: paying off credit card debt transferred from another card
skip_if: you do not have debt to transfer; there is no rewards value if you use it for new purchases
